details: 90s timer wrapped full live pump scan as one monolithic await.
Live scan candidate batch could grow very large from merged hot leaders + leader map + rotation batch.
Pump scan cache TTL and cache usage caused frequent live rescans.
Parent abort/deadline was not propagated to per-symbol pump scan workers.
Pump failure path in cooperative round selection could terminate selection instead of safe scanner fallback.

timeoutBehavior.before: resolveLiveTopGainerPumpCandidates could run until outer 90s timer and raise PUMP_SCAN_FAILED; failure could end candidate selection path early.
timeoutBehavior.after: effective live scan timeout is deadline-aware and respects remaining selection budget; abort propagation is wired; timeout/network failures emit explicit lifecycle telemetry and route to scanner fallback.

implementation: resolvePumpLiveScanTimeoutMs now clamps by selectionDeadlineMs with lower bound for deterministic termination.
runBoundedLivePumpScan accepts parent abortSignal and enforces bounded await with cooperative cancellation.
resolveLiveTopGainerPumpCandidates and scanTopPumpCandidates accept selectionDeadline/abort and bounded maxSymbolsToEvaluate.

implemented: on pump timeout/network failure -> explicit fallback event -> continue full scanner rotation path
safe empty result with explicit PUMP_SCAN_EMPTY telemetry

cowReproduction.evidence: COWTRY is rescued through priority lane and included in cycle evaluation symbols with discoverySource=PRIORITY; no direct trade bypass added.

performanceImpact.summary: Live pump scan symbol evaluation is bounded and cancellable; repeated unnecessary live scans are reduced via cache-aware behavior.
changes: maxSymbolsToEvaluate cap introduced for live pump scan.
Per-symbol market context now runs in cooperative pool with timeout/abort support.
Watcher-aware cache TTL floor reduces redundant live rescans.
Progress callbacks/telemetry improve recovery safety and observability.

details: Pump timeout/failure now records explicit fallback telemetry.
Round selection continues to full scanner when pump scan fails safely.
No zombie behavior observed in controlled 1-round evidence.

controlledValidation.note: Single-round run completed without PUMP_SCAN timeout; round failed at SIM_TIGHT_FILTER stage.

remainingBlockers: Priority candidates may be zero in specific market snapshots; requires additional runtime sampling beyond one round.
Round-level outcomes can still fail due downstream filters (e.g., SIM_TIGHT_FILTER), independent of pump scan timeout.
Further multi-round runtime evidence is still needed before 30-50 round readiness.
